subject: Re: Follow-up: VPC / Dedicated deployment options & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + VPC/dedicated options

Thanks for taking the time earlier today, Sam — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from my side:

- Summary: You’re exploring a high-throughput payments reconciliation workflow (~200 reqs/sec peak, avg 20k tokens/session) and need predictable latency, auditability, and data isolation.
- Primary constraints: SOC 2 / PCI-adjacent compliance, data residency for EU customers, and predictable unit economics.
- Immediate asks from your side: security questionnaire, deployment options doc, and a rough TCO for dedicated vs hosted.

What I’m attaching: redwood-vpc-overview.pdf (VPC / private deployment summary) and a mutual-action-plan.xlsx (high level milestones we discussed).

Recommended next steps:
1) I’ll share a short technical overview and TCO snapshot by end of week (attached).
2) If you’re interested in Dedicated/Private (VPC or on-prem), we should schedule a technical deep-dive with our Solutions Engineer and your infra/security lead — can you propose times next week?
3) Please share the security contact to push the questionnaire to (or I can send it to you to route).

Would you say this is a high priority for Q1 2027 or more of a mid/longer-term initiative? That will help us tailor the proposal.

Thanks — happy to set up the next call.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-vpc-overview.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acmepayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + VPC/dedicated options

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful. A couple quick clarifications from my side:

- Our security lead (Aisha Khan) should be in the loop for the questionnaire — I’ve cc’d her on this reply.
- We’re definitely interested in the Dedicated or VPC option given our PCI-adjacent constraints, but need clarity on:
  * Expected latency difference vs hosted Redwood (p95 targets)
  * Rough pricing band for an initial pilot (2–4 GPUs) and what committed vs burst pricing looks like

We can do a technical deep-dive — Aisha and I are available next Tue/Wed morning PST.

One other ask: do you have a one‑page summary that maps the deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private) to the security controls and audit artifacts we’ll get (e.g., audit logs retention, KMS/HSM integration)?

Appreciate it — Sam

--
Sam Patel
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Payments
sam.patel@acmepayments.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acmepayments.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + VPC/dedicated options

Thanks Sam — great. Looping Aisha in here explicitly.

Quick answers and a proposed plan:

- Latency: For the workloads you described, Dedicated (pinned GPU pool) typically matches hosted p95 within ~10–15% but gives more predictable tail latency under bursty traffic. Private/VPC can match or be slightly better depending on network topology; we’ll validate with a short benchmark during the pilot.
- Pricing: Ballpark for an initial pilot (2x A100-equivalent) starts around $XXk/month committed, with burst capacity available a la carte — I’ll send a calibrated TCO with your expected QPS in the attached TCO spreadsheet.
- Security/artifacts one-pager: see redwood-vpc-overview.pdf (first page is a concise mapping) — I’ll create a tailored one if you want more detail on retention windows and KMS options.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule 60-min technical deep-dive (SE + Aisha) — Tue 2026-11-09 09:00 PST or Wed 2026-11-10 10:00 PST. Please confirm which works.
2) We’ll run an initial security questionnaire and share SOC 2 artifacts; if VPC is the direction, we’ll include network diagrams and KMS integration notes.
3) If helpful, we can draft a short MSA addendum for Dedicated capacity so procurement can start reviewing.

If this is still aimed at Q1 2027, we’ll prioritize a pilot slot in our Dedicated onboarding queue.

Thanks — I can update the mutual-action-plan.xlsx with proposed dates once you confirm.

—
Marissa
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
